The claim states that this method is 'More complex than standard isotropic DVR'. The evidence explicitly details these additional computational steps (eigenanalysis, parameter computation, anisotropic BRDF evaluation) which constitute a higher complexity compared to a standard isotropic approach. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim that the described method is more complex.
